item.title: Under 18s secure Swansea draw
item.description: Millwall's Under 18s drew 1-1 at Swansea City in the Professional Development League on Saturday. The Swans took a second-half lead in South Wales, but Ralphie Beckwith's late penalty-kick ensured a share of the spoils for Chris Perry's side. Next up for Millwall's Under 18s is the visit of AFC Bournemouth on Saturday 31st January. Millwall: Ndikum, Adeniji, Rogers, Tektas, Whiteman, Snelgrove, Payton, Hamann-Chanes, Okine, Wright, Beckwith. Subs: Lindner, Sheikh, Anderson, Debell, Ndige.Fixture

item.title: Lionesses advance to League Cup Quarter-Finals
item.description: Millwall Lionesses defeated Richmond & Kew 4-1 in the League Cup Second Round on Sunday afternoon. Mia Lockett, Liva Helt, Kanita Throp and Kayda Townsend all hit the target - with two goals coming in each half - as Ted Jones' side advanced to the next round at St Paul's. The Lionesses now move into the Quarter-Finals, where they will face Dorking Wanderers at Meadowbank this Sunday (kick-off 3.30pm). Millwall: Deans, Lockett, Joyce, Helt, Squirrell, Coldrick, Bussey, Brooks-Hughes, Richards, Ed

item.title: Deptford Green Secondary School reach EFL Girls' Cup National Finals
item.description: Deptford Green Secondary School, who are representing Millwall at the EFL Girls Cup, have reached the nationals of the competition. After winning the local tournament between schools at The Lions Centre in December, Deptford Green progressed on to the regional stages. The next stage took place at Charlton Athletic’s Sparrow Lane, where the side came second. item.title: Under 21s held to late draw at Swansea
item.description: Millwall's Under 21s were held to a 1-1 draw at Swansea City in the Professional Development League on Tuesday afternoon. Elias Mansor opened the scoring for The Lions, but just as it looked as though Kevin Nugent's side would claim an away victory, Swansea equalised a minute from time through Sam Parker. item.title: Barry Bannan's first words as a Millwall player
item.description: Barry Bannan is a Millwall player. The midfielder has signed for The Lions for an undisclosed fee from Sheffield Wednesday, penning an 18-month contract at The Den. During his media duties, the Scot sat down with Millwall TV+ to discuss his arrival in South London, his hopes for the remainder of 2025/26 and beyond and more - including touching on his departure from Hillsborough. Click play on the video below to hear from Barry.

item.title: Millwall confirm Barry Bannan signing
item.description: Millwall Football Club is delighted to announce the signing of Barry Bannan from Sheffield Wednesday. The midfielder joins The Lions for an undisclosed fee and pens an 18-month contract in SE16. Bannan, 36, moves south after a decade at Hillsborough, where he became an Owls legend after making over 450 appearances across the Sky Bet Championship and League One. item.title: Tickets | Sheffield Wednesday v Millwall
item.description: Millwall travel to Sheffield Wednesday in the Sky Bet Championship on Saturday 14th February (kick-off 3pm) - and tickets will go on sale to season ticket holders from 9.30am on Thursday 29th January. All tickets for this fixture will be issued as digital/print at home and will start to be sent from Monday 9th February. Please ensure you have the correct email address on your ticketing account. Tickets will go on sale to members from 9.30am on Monday 2nd February. Tickets are priced at £30 adult
